items.q: What exactly is GOTCHA?
items.a: One AI-powered platform for all your customer communication. It unifies every channel into a single inbox and adds an AI Employee and Co-Pilot that don't just chat - they take real actions and turn every conversation into customer intelligence in your CRM.

items.q: Does the AI actually take actions, or is it just a chatbot?
items.a: It takes real actions. The AI Employee understands a request and handles it end-to-end - looking up the order, starting an exchange, sending tracking, updating your CRM - not just sending canned replies.

items.q: Will it replace my human agents?
items.a: No. It handles the routine and hands off to a human the moment it matters - with the full customer context in one view. The Co-Pilot then makes your agents faster, and Call-Pilot guides them live on phone calls.

items.q: Which channels does it support?
items.a: WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, email, web chat and Slack - plus phone calls, where AI Call-Pilot guides your agents live. Every channel in one unified inbox, with full cross-channel history per customer.

items.q: How much control do I have over what the AI does?
items.a: Full control. You set the autonomy level per action - from suggest-only, to ask-me-first (human-in-the-loop), to fully autonomous. Sensitive actions like refunds or discounts can always require approval.

items.q: Does it connect to my CRM and tools?
items.a: Yes. Conversations are summarized and synced to your CRM/ERP, the customer profile is enriched automatically, and tasks and follow-ups are created for you - no copy-paste.

items.q: How fast can we get started?
items.a: Fast. Connect your channels, add your knowledge base, and invite your team - most teams are live the same day.

items.q: Is our data safe?
items.a: Encrypted in transit and at rest, with role-based access and strict per-tenant isolation. We never sell or share your data.

credits.intro: Credits are how GOTCHA measures AI work. A conversation consumes credits as the AI reads it, drafts a reply, retrieves knowledge, updates your CRM and summarises the outcome. Longer conversations, voice calls and more AI actions consume more.

p1.title: Included every month
p1.body: Each plan includes a monthly allowance. It resets on your renewal date and does not roll over.

p2.title: Buy more at any time
p2.body: Prepaid credit packages are added to your balance and stay there until you use them. Plan credits are consumed first.

p3.title: Automatic top-up, on your terms
p3.body: Turn on automatic top-up and set a monthly spending limit. Nothing is charged beyond the limit you set.

p4.title: When credits run out
p4.body: AI actions stop until credits are added. Your inbox, history and human agents keep working, and nothing is deleted.

items.q: What is a credit?
items.a: A credit is how GOTCHA measures AI work. Reading a message, drafting a reply, retrieving knowledge, updating your CRM and summarising a conversation all draw on your balance. Credits are the only unit you are billed in.

items.q: How are conversation estimates calculated?
items.a: Each plan is configured with a commercial assumption about how many credits an average conversation uses, and how many business days a month contains. The estimate divides the plan's credit allowance by that assumption. It describes the plan configuration, not a measurement of anyone's usage.

items.q: Will my usage match the estimate?
items.a: Not exactly. Actual credit consumption varies by conversation length, channel, AI actions, enabled features and voice duration. The estimate is there to size a plan, not to predict a bill.

items.q: What happens when credits run out?
items.a: AI actions stop until credits are added. Your shared inbox, conversation history and human agents keep working, and no data is removed. You can buy credits or enable automatic top-up.

items.q: How does automatic top-up work?
items.a: You choose when it triggers, how much it buys, and a monthly spending limit. Once the limit is reached nothing further is charged, and you are notified so you can decide what to do.

items.q: Can I buy extra credits without changing plan?
items.a: Yes. Prepaid credit packages are added to your balance and stay there until consumed. Included plan credits are always used first.

items.q: What happens when I upgrade?
items.a: An upgrade starts immediately. You are charged the prorated difference for the rest of the current billing period, and the larger credit allowance is available straight away.

items.q: What happens when I downgrade?
items.a: Your current plan stays exactly as it is until your renewal date. Nothing is removed before then, and the smaller plan starts at renewal.

items.q: What happens if I cancel?
items.a: Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. You keep full access until your renewal date, and you can resume before it. Your data is not deleted when the subscription ends.

items.q: Why are prices shown in dollars?
items.a: Prices are set in US dollars. Shekel amounts are a display conversion at the official representative rate, rounded up, and are marked as an estimate. The currency you will actually be charged in is shown before you confirm.

items.q: Do you offer a trial or a pilot?
items.a: Trials and pilots are arranged with our team rather than started self-serve, so the credit budget and duration can be set to match what you want to evaluate. Ask us when you get in touch.

items.q: Can we get a custom plan?
items.a: Yes. Custom plans set their own capabilities, limits, credit allocation and volumes, with commercial terms agreed with you.

shopifyInstall.step5Title: Turn on the chat in your theme
shopifyInstall.step5Body: Shopify keeps app embeds switched off until you enable them. This link opens your live theme with GOTCHA Chat ready to turn on. Switch it on, then click Save.
shopifyInstall.step5AfterSave: After you save, open your storefront once. We watch for the first page load and confirm it here.
shopifyInstall.noDeepLink: The activation link is not available yet. Open Online Store, then Themes, then Customize, then App embeds, and turn on GOTCHA Chat.
shopifyInstall.noSession: We could not find a recent Shopify installation for this browser. Start again from your Shopify admin.
shopifyInstall.noOrganizations: This account has no active organization that can hold a channel. Ask an administrator to invite you, or create one first.
shopifyInstall.claimedElsewhere: This store is already connected to a different GOTCHA organization. Sign in with an account in that organization, or contact support to move it.
shopifyInstall.bindFailed: We could not connect the store.
shopifyInstall.failedBody: Shopify could not finish the installation.
shopifyInstall.failedRetry: Open the app again from your Shopify admin to retry.
shopifyInstall.advancedManual: A channel key and manual domain entry exist in chat settings for recovery only. A normal installation never needs them.

state.EMBED_ENABLED_NOT_SEEN: Waiting for the first page load on your storefront.

noAccess.title: You don't have access to this page
noAccess.subtitle: Ask a workspace admin if you need access.

whatsappNumbers.title: WhatsApp numbers
whatsappNumbers.subtitle: Connect a number for each team, store or country. Each one works on its own.
whatsappNumbers.loadFailed: We could not load your WhatsApp numbers.
whatsappNumbers.noneYet: No WhatsApp numbers are connected yet.

card.removeBody: GOTCHA will stop sending and receiving on {number}. Your other WhatsApp numbers keep working exactly as they are, and the number itself stays yours.
card.genericError: That did not work. Try again shortly.

pending.pinBody: This number has two-step verification switched on. Enter the 6-digit PIN you set for it. WhatsApp does not let anyone else reset it, so if you cannot recall it you will need to change it in WhatsApp first.
pending.confirmTitle: Confirm in your WhatsApp Business app
pending.confirmBody: Follow the instructions shown by Meta and confirm the connection in your WhatsApp Business app. Only you can complete this step, which is how WhatsApp makes sure nobody connects your number without you.
pending.registerTitle: One step left: register this number
pending.registerBody: WhatsApp has this number but has not registered it for sending yet. Enter a 6-digit PIN and press Finish setup. If two-step verification is already switched on for this number, use its existing PIN. If one has never been set, choose one now - it becomes this number's PIN, so keep it somewhere safe.

add.title: Add a WhatsApp number
add.subtitle: Connect another number for a different team, store or country. Your existing numbers keep working while you do it.
add.notConfigured: WhatsApp connection is not configured in this environment yet.
add.sdkUnavailable: WhatsApp's sign-in window could not load. It comes straight from WhatsApp, so a browser extension or a network filter can stop it reaching you. Reload the page, and if it keeps happening let your IT team know that connect.facebook.net needs to be allowed.
add.sdkFailed: WhatsApp's sign-in window would not open. Reload the page and try again.
add.cancelled: You closed the WhatsApp window before finishing.
add.inspectFailed: We could not read your WhatsApp setup. Try connecting again in a moment.
add.connectFailed: We could not connect that number.
add.noCode: The WhatsApp setup finished, but Meta did not return an authorization code, so there was nothing to connect with. This is usually the Embedded Signup configuration rather than anything about your number. Try again, and if it repeats, tell us and we will read the exact response.

choose.title: Choose the number to connect
choose.degraded: Some of your WhatsApp setup could not be checked, so this list may be incomplete.

outcome.allAlreadyConnected: Every number WhatsApp offered is already connected to this workspace. There is nothing new to add.
outcome.allBlocked: None of the numbers WhatsApp offered can be connected right now. The reason for each one is shown above.
outcome.unknown: We could not find a number to connect.
outcome.noCandidates: WhatsApp did not offer any numbers to connect. If the number you want is already set up elsewhere, disconnect it there first.

legacy.note: Connected before per-number health was available. Reconnect it to enable health checks and repair.

headline.working: This number is working. Messages send and arrive normally.
headline.receivingOnly: Connected. Customer messages are arriving normally. Sending is blocked by WhatsApp until the account issue below is resolved.
headline.sendingOnly: This number can send, but incoming messages are not reaching GOTCHA yet.
headline.neither: This number is connected, but messages are not flowing yet.
